purpose: Teach: 読み書き/本誌/常務/出回っ/既婚/上述/免責/全長

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、読み書き能力の啓発もされてますね
lines.en: The police do conduct public awareness campaigns on literacy, don't they.
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal acknowledgment. Steady eye contact, nodding incrementally. The tone of someone confirming facts they already understand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本誌のインタビュー取材にもご対応ですね
lines.en: And your department does participate in interviews with our magazine as well, I see.
lines.style: Respectful, professional courtesy. A pause before 'as well'—making note of the cooperation. Warm but not overly familiar.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本部の常務会議で防犯方針を共有されますね
lines.en: The crime prevention policy is shared at headquarters management meetings, yes?
lines.style: Methodical, fact-checking tone. Slight uplift at the end—a genuine question underneath the statement. Engaged, not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市中に出回っている偽造硬貨を捜査されますね
lines.en: I understand the department also investigates counterfeit coins circulating in the market.
lines.style: Conversational but deliberate. A touch of respect for the specificity of the work. Lean-in interest without pressing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、既婚者の家庭内事案にもご対応ですね
lines.en: You handle domestic cases involving married couples as well, then.
lines.style: Quiet shift in tone—slightly more serious. Delicate acknowledgment of sensitive territory. Measured pace, careful word choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、上述の通り、捜査を進められますね
lines.en: And as mentioned, the investigation moves forward from there.
lines.style: Calm, summarizing. A slight exhale—moving past detail to larger picture. Professional clarity without rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、免責事項を被害者ご家族にもご説明されますね
lines.en: You also explain the liability disclaimers to the victim's family, naturally.
lines.style: Gentle pivot. Acknowledging duty without judgment. Quiet respect for a necessary but difficult conversation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑車両の全長まで記録されてますね
lines.en: Even the total length of the suspect vehicle is recorded in your files.
lines.style: Impressed, attentive. A slight lean forward. The satisfaction of discovering thoroughness in the details. Warmer than before.
